The queue mixes products with and without duplex (back) items.
Remove work orders or use only products of the same type.
duplex.pdftoprinter_unsupported:
PDFtoPrinter does not support per-job duplex.
Use Ghostscript or Win32 DEVMODE in settings, or remove duplex items from the layout.

landscape.mixed_batch:
The queue mixes portrait and landscape sheet products.
Remove work orders or use only products with the same sheet orientation.
landscape.pdftoprinter_unsupported:
PDFtoPrinter does not support per-job landscape orientation.
Use Ghostscript or Win32 DEVMODE in settings, or set the sheet to portrait.
